normalized.title: Complex Systems Perspectives on Education and the Education System
normalized.summary: Overview: Individual human beings are highly complex and together they form yet more complex socio-economic systems. Our current school system, with its successes and failures during the industrial era, may not be well suited for the post-industrial information society.
